_about: Golden evaluation set for Aegis AI quality. Grounded in the seeded NDA/consulting contracts. Retrieval checks are free (no LLM); faithfulness checks generate an answer and cost tokens (run with --faithfulness).

brain_queries.question: What is the confidentiality survival period after termination?
What governing law applies to these agreements?
What remedies are available for breach of confidentiality?
Can the agreement be assigned to a third party?
What must happen to confidential information on termination?
When may confidential information be disclosed to third parties?

extraction_taxonomy._about: Canonical clause types (CUAD-aligned) expected somewhere in the portfolio of NDAs/consulting agreements.
